mapper.select: SELECT id, version, session_id, title, kb_id, user_id, tenant_id, llm_model_id, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, message_count, total_tokens, total_cost, status, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at FROM ai_chat_session WHERE id = #{sessionId}
